drafts.title: Countdown
drafts.pitch: Cursor puts a three-day countdown on the wall for the end of the silence; at zero the handset still doesn't ring, and the display flips to counting up. Another version of Naomi's idea (issue #64).
drafts.reason: The countdown flipping to +0:00:01 is a good visual for the number still moving, but the display didn't match 'three days' and Tilde's extra 'Do you?' weakens her closer.

drafts.title: Circled
drafts.pitch: Cursor circles a day on a tear-off calendar as the end of the silence; when the page tears off, it circles the next one. Another version of Naomi's idea (issue #64).
drafts.reason: Reads clearly, but circling the next day replaces counting with rescheduling, so the closing exchange loses some of its meaning.
